name: plans
checks: monthly_price >= 0 AND annual_price >= 0 AND student_limit > 0 AND campus_limit > 0

name: subscriptions
checks: kind IN ('paid','trial') AND grace_days <= 30 AND (student_limit IS NULL OR student_limit > 0) AND (campus_limit IS NULL OR campus_limit > 0)

name: students
checks: (identity_number IS NULL AND identity_type IS NULL) OR (identity_number IS NOT NULL AND identity_number REGEXP '^[0-9]{13}$' AND identity_type IS NOT NULL AND identity_type IN ('cnic','b_form'))

name: guardians
checks: cnic IS NULL OR cnic REGEXP '^[0-9]{13}$'

name: enrollments
checks: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

name: fee_plans
checks: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

name: student_concessions
checks: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

name: test_results
checks: (status = 'present' AND marks IS NOT NULL AND marks >= 0) OR (status <> 'present' AND marks IS NULL)

name: salary_structures
checks: ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on

name: visitor_logs
checks: exited_at IS NULL OR exited_at >= entered_at
